localDeltaObservation.evidence: Default main is 21 commits ahead and 0 behind the upstream main merge base. Local-ahead changes include the NeoForge 1.21.1 port, bilingual documentation, build/release workflows, pricing and payment code, GameTests, packaged-JAR validation, restart integration, licensing/NOTICE, and dedicated-server validation tooling.

understandability.claim: The local-ahead README documents purpose, Minecraft/NeoForge/Java/FTB compatibility, installation, command semantics, transaction ordering, configuration, pricing, migration, troubleshooting, source-build validation, and fork attribution.

verification.claim: The main-branch push workflow explicitly checked out exact revision 22d7adcbe5f711a3bc7e2cb8593c60e19838dce1 and passed unit tests/build, packaged release-JAR verification, all six required NeoForge GameTests, FTB Chunks purchase-and-restart integration, dedicated-server startup to Done, and evidence artifact upload.

Local-ahead GameTests cover command registration, multi-stack payment, insufficient-payment no-consumption behavior, default pricing, real /buyclaim quota/payment behavior, and second-JVM quota persistence.

reproducibility.claim: The local delta records the Java 21 / Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1 toolchain and dependency/build contract together with executable clean-test-build, GameTest, restart-integration, JAR-audit, and server-smoke workflow steps.

The exact-head workflow produced the named buyclaimchunks-22d7adc... evidence artifact and recorded upload digest 3fbaa4eecba431bafdf24b051c0353395f83477c6f144c39bc37062ce03aac88; this proves a bounded successful build artifact, not byte-identical rebuild determinism.

interoperability.claim: The local delta specifies the supported Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1, FTB Chunks 2101.1.x, FTB Teams, FTB Library, and Architectury compatibility boundary and preserves a separate legacy Forge branch.

The exact-head runtime loaded BuyClaimChunks Continued with FTB Chunks 2101.1.20, FTB Teams 2101.1.9, FTB Library 2101.1.30, Architectury 13.0.8 and NeoForge 21.1.242, then verified a real quota purchase and reload through FTB's persisted data path.

security-safety.claim: The local transaction contract updates FTB quota before consuming payment, rejects invalid/overflowed/insufficient transactions, and includes a GameTest asserting insufficient payment leaves inventory unchanged.

stewardship.claim: The local delta adds an MIT license, preserves original-author attribution and fork provenance in NOTICE/README, documents maintained-version boundaries, and records release changes.
